sourceFindings.finding: ApplicationsService.listDashApplicationInstances uses GET /dash/applications/{application_id}/instances with per_page/page_token. fetchAllRows follows next_page_token and accumulates raw instances and durable_objects separately. buildInstanceRows joins durable_objects[].deployment_id to instances[].id; rowsToJsonOutput labels a DO without a joined instance inactive. With any DO rows, that display projection can omit orphan/unjoined instances; it cannot replace raw instances inspection.

Container.getState returns SDK ContainerState. Missing persisted ContainerState creates/stores a default stopped state. Container construction also initializes schedules and schedules/renews alarms/activity. It is not a zero-write physical probe and must not be invoked on the six historical IDs.

archiveRuntimeResources reads the identity-bound original stored runtime/isolation evidence without its release factory. Normal cold release uses destroyAndReleaseState, immediate running observation, 360000ms assignment guard and 30000ms quiet interval before immutable runtime-released/capacity confirmation. Those immutable receipts are distinct from fresh control-plane placement inventory.

Retained pair release requires both original domain proofs: never-started if unclaimed, otherwise running=false after the original destroy path plus assignment/quiet guards. Idle/handoff is retained occupancy. destroyAndReleaseState/destroyWorkspaceLease mutate/fence/stop; they are not read-only probes. Scope assertions can write native owner binding.

The #248 operator quiescence GET proves original Beta/cold/pair ledgers under the exact live barrier and returns actualContainerReleaseVerified=false. It does not call a runtime container. No existing reviewed operator GET was found that reads ctx.container.running for arbitrary raw history IDs without SDK construction. The Dash control-plane read avoids needing that new route or runtime RPC.

officialSources.finding: An instance ID is the 64-hex Durable Object actor ID. GET reports the last reported logical-instance state; inactive is a lifecycle enum, without an SDK-running=false or application-release guarantee.
instances-v2 supports cursor pagination, state and name filters; omission of filters is needed for the whole app inventory. Historical inactive records need not disappear.

The deprecated /instances endpoint is replaced by instances-v2. Current documentation does not establish it as a separate physical-only placement authority. This review relies on the verified installed Dash raw shape instead.
ctx.container.running and inspect are separate platform observations; start/destroy are lifecycle actions. No real method is called by this review.
SDK getState exposes running/healthy/stopping/stopped/stopped_with_code. It has different semantics and side-effect boundaries from the REST inactive enum.

fixedReadContract.nextQuery: same original account/app/path/per_page plus exact next_page_token only
fixedReadContract.readRaw: Require success=true, result.instances array and optional durable_objects array; keep both raw populations separate. Inspect every placement row, including unjoined/orphan rows. Do not use CLI row count or inactive display as the authority.
fixedReadContract.pagination: The supplied reader uses result_info.next_page_token, rejects repeated/truthy malformed cursors and stops held at four pages. Never promote a page cap to completeness. No further page was requested for the supplied one-page result.
fixedReadContract.futureReceiptTightening: Preserve result_info and explicit terminal cursor in the next held read receipt; reject non-string malformed cursors (including false/0) rather than treating falsy malformed data as end-of-list. This is a future reader hardening note, not evidence of a malformed current response.

futurePreRolloutConjunction: Separately authorized fixed source/deployment/app/account/image/configuration, unexpired human grant, existing Legacy/G5/M3/M4 gates and sole-writer boundaries must be verified.

Keep the same original #248 maintenance hold/request/operator/authVersion/revision/policy/control epoch valid throughout; use its fresh combined Beta/native quiescence GET and immutable original terminal validators. No end/begin cycle.

Perform fresh complete unfiltered instances-v2 and raw Dash reads after the hold and drain; original app/account identity and logical history must agree. Historical inactive DO rows may remain. Unknown, contradictory, paginated-incomplete or unjoined active placement evidence stops the action.

Require raw Dash placement population empty for this bounded rollout contract. This app-scoped control-plane observation, together with original terminal ledgers, avoids activating six Sandbox SDK objects or restoring archived projects. It is not OS/global absolute-zero proof.
futurePostRolloutConjunction: Reconcile only the original accepted rollout identity: exact rollout GET must report completed and the expected target version. Do not infer terminal status from a limited history list; no new POST on unknown ACK.
Read the same app back: expected digest-pinned image from the frozen input, original application identity and all non-image configuration fields exactly preserved, including max1/default/basic.

While the same hold is still valid, repeat fresh combined original ledger proof and full raw placement/history inventory. Require placements0, preserve the original six history IDs, and reconcile any new history entry to the original authorized rollout identity.

Only after all conjuncts pass may the exact original maintenance end CAS be considered under its explicit grant. If any placement remains/new placement appears, controls drift, identity/terminal is unknown or readback is incomplete, keep the hold and stop. Do not start model acceptance, automatically stop/destroy containers, rollback or retry.
remainingGaps: The reviewed receipts are point-in-time unheld observations; future held pre/post evidence is still required.

The six history IDs are matched across logical and Dash inventory, but no per-DO runtime/container release mapping was asserted or newly fetched. Empty complete raw app placements plus original terminal authority is the proposed aggregate control-plane criterion.
No direct ctx.container.running observation, OS VM/CPU attestation, multi-writer lock or deployment/config CAS is established by these APIs.
